$comment: Open questions carried into the Evidence Index (C2) for a human to decide. Read by evidence:index only.
match.texts: exact L texts (compared verbatim, never normalised) — the index links every vocabulary entry
and frame that shows one, and keeps the text unchanged while the item is open.
match.record_screen_query_id: true — the index links every frame whose route carries a record id in its
query string but was not treated as a record screen (the deferred Option B gap in pii-regions.json).
To resolve an item set status to "resolved" and write the decision in resolution; then rebuild the index.

items.question: The Add Member form's placeholders use a person-shaped example name. It is fixed app copy, not record data, but a real member may share the name. Show it verbatim in the manual, or use a neutral example?
